# discord_application_command (List Resource)

Lists the global commands of the bot's application, or its commands in one server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_application_command" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id = var.server_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list the commands of. Omit to list global commands.
